overview: The Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities met to introduce recommended new members, discuss city website accessibility improvements, review ARPA funding requests, and address physical accessibility at outdoor community events.

items.title: Welcome and Introductions
items.summary: Commissioners and newly recommended members introduced themselves and shared their personal and professional backgrounds.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission tabled the approval of past meeting minutes to January because the recommended commissioners' paperwork was not yet finalized.

items.title: Commission Webpage Accessibility Update
items.summary: Linda Braden reported on efforts with the city's communications director to remove broken links and improve accessibility standards on the commission's webpage during the city's website migration.

items.title: ARPA Funds, Training, and Disability Awareness Event
items.summary: Frances Nwajei announced the arrival of ARPA-funded accessible signage stencils, detailed a $7,850 ARPA request for commission outreach materials, and discussed planning a disability awareness event for April.

items.title: MHOA Mini-Grant Update
items.summary: Nwajei reported that an MHOA mini-grant application could not move forward due to a lack of required city data.

items.title: Public Health and Disability Seminar Report
items.summary: Marcia Kirssen summarized key takeaways from a Boston University School of Public Health seminar concerning healthcare discrimination and broad definitions of disability.

items.title: Outdoor Event Accessibility
items.summary: Commissioners discussed addressing physical barriers at local outdoor festivals, proposing options such as purchasing portable grass mats or cataloging accessible city venues.

items.title: Announcements and Adjournment
items.summary: Members shared brief closing announcements, including a resident's proposal for an inclusive marathon, before adjourning.
